lines.trans: Fyodor, prepare two portions of shrimp.
A chef should shout at cooks!
Arseny, you deserve respectful treatment.
But strict discipline is needed in the kitchen.
You have the cleanest workstation.
Where is the hot dish for table three?
The guests have been waiting forty minutes already!
Sasha, calmly, let us breathe deeply.
This dish takes over an hour to cook.
They threaten to leave without paying.
Ask the guests to wait a little longer.
New order: partridge and mushrooms.
We will make everything on time, chef!

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to prepare, get ready', paired with 'приготовиться'.
